name: 1-2-4-All
deliverable: Progressive silent reflection, paired synthesis, quartet convergence

steps.text: Pose one question worth the room's attention, then give everyone a minute of silent writing.
Give pairs two minutes to agree on one point.
Have fours spend four minutes finding one pattern.
Harvest only themes the room has not heard yet.

failure: The silent minute becomes chatter, the loudest voice frames the pair, and the plenary repeats itself.
intervention: Restart the timer and say the first minute is solo; early talk lets the quickest voice set the frame.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
